chalisa.do1: Victory, victory, victory to the purifier of the world; victory to the Gaṅgā, the river of the gods. Victory to her who dwells in Śiva's matted locks, with her peerless, lofty waves.
chalisa.cau1: Victory to you, Queen Gaṅgā, mother of the world, remover of the mine of sin, bringer of joy. ॥1॥
chalisa.cau2: Victory to you, Bhāgīrathī, Mother, river of the gods, famed as the one who destroys the impurity of Kali at its root. ॥2॥
chalisa.cau3: Victory, victory to you, daughter of Jahnu, destroyer of sin, mother of Bhīṣma and mother of the world. ॥3॥
chalisa.cau4: White lotus petals adorn my body; seeing it, the beauty of a hundred autumn moons is put to shame. ॥4॥
chalisa.cau5: Your mount, the makara, pure and spotless, looks splendid; the pitcher of nectar in your hand enchants the mind that sees it. ॥5॥
chalisa.cau6: Your golden ornaments are studded with gems; on your breast a necklace of jewels takes away darkness and blemish. ॥6॥
chalisa.cau7: Purifier of the world, destroyer of the three afflictions, your lofty, rippling waves delight the mind. ॥7॥
chalisa.cau8: Gaṇapati is most worthy of worship and foremost; yet even before him comes bathing in the Gaṅgā. ॥8॥
chalisa.cau9: Goddess who dwells in Brahmā's water-pot, you serve the Lord's lotus feet with joy. ॥9॥
chalisa.cau10: You delivered the sixty thousand sons of Sagara and established the holy place of Gaṅgāsāgara. ॥10॥
chalisa.cau11: Seeing the lovely holy place of Haridvāra, your fathomless waves rose up, delighting the mind. ॥11॥
chalisa.cau12: Passing Prayāga, king of holy places, and its undying banyan, Mother, you then took a turn at Kāśī. ॥12॥
chalisa.cau13: Blessed, blessed are you, river of the gods, stairway to heaven, saviour of countless generations of ancestors. ॥13॥
chalisa.cau14: Bhagīratha performed boundless austerities; then Brahmā gave the stream of the river of the gods. ॥14॥
chalisa.cau15: When the mother of the world went rushing and roaring, she was held fast in Śiva's matted locks. ॥15॥
chalisa.cau16: For years Queen Gaṅgā remained lost in Śiva's matted locks. ॥16॥
chalisa.cau17: The sage Bhagīratha meditated on Śiva; then he received one drop from the matted locks. ॥17॥
chalisa.cau18: From it the Mother became three streams: in the world of mortals, in the sky and in the netherworld. ॥18॥
chalisa.cau19: To the netherworld went the stream named Prabhāvatī; to the sky went the lovely Mandākinī. ॥19॥
chalisa.cau20: In the world of mortals is the lovely Jāhnavī, remover of Kali's impurity, fathomless, purifier of the world. ॥20॥
chalisa.cau21: Blessed are you, Mother, and great is your glory; you are the axle of dharma and an axe to the sins of Kali. ॥21॥
chalisa.cau22: Blessed is Mother Prabhāvatī, blessed is Mandākinī, blessed is the river of the gods, destroyer of all fear. ॥22॥
chalisa.cau23: Those who drink the pure water of the Gaṅgā gain endless fruits that the heart desires. ॥23॥
chalisa.cau24: When the merit of past births awakens, then alone does the mind turn in meditation to the Gaṅgā. ॥24॥
chalisa.cau25: As many steps as one takes towards the river of the gods, the fruit of so many aśvamedha sacrifices one gains. ॥25॥
chalisa.cau26: Great sinners whom no one could save, your one name has saved. ॥26॥
chalisa.cau27: Those who meditate on you even from a hundred yojanas away surely gain a place in Viṣṇu's world. ॥27॥
chalisa.cau28: Worshipping your name destroys countless sins, and pure knowledge, strength and intellect shine forth. ॥28॥
chalisa.cau29: Just as dharma and giving are the root of wealth, so drinking the water of the Gaṅgā is the root of dharma. ॥29॥
chalisa.cau30: When your virtues are dwelt on, sorrow flees, and wealth and good sense abide in every home. ॥30॥
chalisa.cau31: By meditating daily on the Gaṅgā with due observance, even the wicked attain the state of the good. ॥31॥
chalisa.cau32: The witless gains learning and strength; the sick is freed from disease. ॥32॥
chalisa.cau33: Men who say Gaṅgā, Gaṅgā are never left hungry or unclothed. ॥33॥
chalisa.cau34: As soon as the words Mother Gaṅgā leave the mouth, Yama stops his ears and runs away. ॥34॥
chalisa.cau35: You carry across great sinners and the lowest of the low; the doors of hell have been shut. ॥35॥
chalisa.cau36: The man who repeats the hundred names of the Gaṅgā has all his wishes accomplished and fulfilled. ॥36॥
chalisa.cau37: They enjoy every happiness, attain the supreme state, and are freed from coming and going in birth and death. ॥37॥
chalisa.cau38: Blessed are you, Mother, river of the gods, giver of happiness; blessed, blessed is Triveṇī, king of holy places. ॥38॥
chalisa.cau39: Of the village of Kakarā, by the sage Durvāsā's hermitage, Sundaradāsa is the servant of the Gaṅgā. ॥39॥
chalisa.cau40: Whoever reads this Gaṅgā Chālīsā gains unbroken devotion and becomes a master of speech. ॥40॥
chalisa.do2: Those who hold the Gaṅgā in meditation gain ever-new happiness and wealth; at the end they dwell in the city of the gods, seated with honour in a celestial car.
chalisa.do3: In the year arm, sky, direction, on the day of Rāma's birth in Caitra, I completed this Chālīsā for the good of Hari's devotees, as an eye for them.
